name: codebase-kg
description: Builds, maintains, and serves a per-repo knowledge graph — a structured, source-derived map of any codebase (nodes = components, edges = relationships) so an agent can orient and find code without re-deriving the map every session. Language-agnostic. Cross-codebase parity linking tracks feature gaps between paired repos (e.g. an iOS app and its Android port). Advisory only.
